visualizations.summary: 亲手调节单比特极角 θ、方位相位 φ、环境记录重叠角 α 与退相干捏合强度 η，实时观测几何积 AB = A·B + A∧B 的内积粒子线 cos θ 与外积波动面 sin θ、记录可区分度与相干可见度的勾股圆 D² + V² = 1、SU(2)/SO(3) 旋子门序列以及希尔伯特—施密特捏合正交分解与相对熵删除账单。
visualizations.summary_en: Interactively adjust qubit polar angle θ, azimuthal phase φ, environmental record overlap angle α, and pinching decoherence strength η to inspect the geometric product AB = A·B + A∧B, the Pythagorean complementarity circle D² + V² = 1, SU(2)/SO(3) Clifford rotor gates, and the Hilbert–Schmidt pinching decomposition and relative-entropy deletion ledger.
